_comment: ACTIVATED_ABILITY_OR_ACTION_CARD_EFFECT was set by nothing, and the trigger was ON_ENTER_PLAY -- this card goes to hand or arsenal, never to the arena, so even a working flag would have gated a trigger that could not fire. Zone.add is the only place that knows the previous zone, whether the card is face up, and whether an EFFECT rather than a game rule moved it (engine.context), so the trigger is dispatched from there. Narrowing 'a card effect' further to 'an ACTIVATED ability or ACTION card effect' specifically is not modelled: the effect context records the source card, not whether the ability was activated or triggered.
